title: Notifications can overlap panels in Auto-Hide mode
line: Notification popups no longer cover an auto-hiding panel when it is revealed.
explanation: Notification popups are positioned inside the containment's available screen area, which leaves out always-visible panels but includes auto-hiding ones. With the notification widget on an auto-hiding panel, popups were placed right at the screen edge, so revealing the panel to reach the tray left them covering its clock and icons. The popup area now also excludes the panel holding the notification widget, on whichever edge it is.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Keep popups clear of an auto-hiding panel

Popups are placed in the available screen area, which includes panels
that auto-hide, so revealing the panel holding the notification widget
left the popups covering it. Now popups also keep clear of that panel.

BUG: 512614

media.caption: Bottom panel set to Auto-Hide, revealed: the notification popup covers the tray and clock
Same steps with the fix: the popup sits above the revealed panel

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (applets/notifications Globals.qml) that keeps popups clear of the panel holding the notification widget by clamping screenRect against the panel window on its screen edge. This matches existing Dodge Windows behavior without affecting availableScreenRect for maximized windows or desktop icons, handles all four edges and multi-monitor/vertical layouts safely, and is well-verified by the before/after screenshots and regression notes. (Minor non-blocking nit: the horizontal width-restriction block immediately below can reuse panelWindow instead of re-reading visualParent.Window.window.)

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (applets/notifications Globals.qml) that keeps popups clear of the panel holding the notification widget by clamping screenRect against the panel window on its screen edge. This matches existing Dodge Windows behavior without affecting availableScreenRect for maximized windows or desktop icons, handles all four edges and multi-monitor/vertical layouts safely, and is well-verified by the before/after screenshots and regression notes. (Minor non-blocking nit: the horizontal width-restriction block immediately below can reuse panelWindow instead of re-reading visualParent.Window.window.)

Fixes the reported overlap: the popup area now also excludes the window of the panel that holds the notification widget, on whichever edge it sits, using the same Window.window geometry that screenRect already uses for the panel-width limit. When that panel is Always Visible the change does nothing, because availableScreenRect already leaves it out, so there is no regression there. It is a targeted fix rather than Nate's full plan (auto-hide state from the shell, avoiding all auto-hide panels), and the notes say so plainly. The screenshots show the popup moving from over the tray to just above it.
